triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: A year before the end of the course he suddenly announced to the ladies that he was going to see his father about a plan which had occurred to him.

triples.subject: Yefim Petrovitch Polenov
triples.quote: When he entered the household of his patron and benefactor, Yefim Petrovitch Polenov, he gained the hearts of all the family, so that they looked on him quite as their own child.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Three or four years after his wife’s death he had gone to the south of Russia and finally turned up in Odessa, where he spent several years.
